projects.title: InfrX Mortgage Pipeline
projects.description: Segments 100–2,000 page mortgage packages into 27 document types at 91% accuracy. Cost-aware cascade (pdfplumber → heuristics → GPT-4o-mini VLM) so most pages never reach an LLM; Probabilistic Table Threading (Naive Bayes over 5 signals) auto-stitches ~85% of cross-page tables. Validated on 2,295 pages.

projects.title: Evidence Verifier
projects.description: Is this document real? Verifies dispute evidence and GST invoices with cryptographic and arithmetic ground truth (signed QRs, GSTN e-invoice payloads, GSTIN checksums) instead of pixel forensics, which is blind to AI inpainting. Tested on 9 independent corpora: 15 real GSTINs accepted, 0 false positives.

projects.title: Risk Copilot
projects.description: AML copilot that takes an analyst from a fraud signal to a cited, machine-checked SAR entirely inside Snowflake. 5 deterministic rules mapped to policy clauses — the LLM never decides what is fraud. Precision 0.71–1.00 on a held-out dataset; append-only decisions, PII masked even inside AI answers, 36/36 governance checks.

projects.description: Space-enabled waste intelligence for Bengaluru: Sentinel-2 dump detection (Random Forest, 2/2 ground-truth sites matched), XGBoost risk prediction over a 552-cell grid, and route optimisation cutting ~40% of daily distance. 9 ML models behind a 34-endpoint FastAPI + Next.js platform.

Worked on protocol frameworks for India's Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) using C++ and Python.
Contributed to hardware-bound cryptographic validation and data integrity verification systems.
